newsitem.title: USA: Apollo stockholders approve share increase.
newsitem.headline: Apollo stockholders approve share increase.

text.p: Apollo Group Inc said its shareholders voted in favor of an amendment to increase the number of authorized shares of Class A common stock to 400 million from 65 million.

The increase will ensure that the company has enough shares available for stock splits or dividends, establishing strategic relationships, securing financing or providing incentives to employees, officers or directors, Apollo said.
The company said the additional shares also may be issued to acquire or invest in other businesses.
